parameters.query:
WITH loc AS (
  SELECT id, company_id, name AS location_name
  FROM locations WHERE id = '{{ $json.body.location_id }}'::uuid
),
calc AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(gs.fuel_consumed), 0) AS fuel_litres_calculated
  FROM generator_sessions gs
  JOIN generators g ON g.id = gs.generator_id
  WHERE g.location_id = '{{ $json.body.location_id }}'::uuid
    AND gs.session_start >= '{{ $json.body.period_start }}'::date
    AND gs.session_start < '{{ $json.body.period_end }}'::date + INTERVAL '1 day'
),
rep AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fl.volume_litres), 0) AS fuel_litres_reported
  FROM fuel_logs fl
  JOIN generators g ON g.id = fl.generator_id
  WHERE g.location_id = '{{ $json.body.location_id }}'::uuid
    AND fl.type = 'income'
    AND fl.created_at >= '{{ $json.body.period_start }}'::date
    AND fl.created_at < '{{ $json.body.period_end }}'::date + INTERVAL '1 day'
)
SELECT 
  loc.company_id, 
  loc.location_name,
  calc.fuel_litres_calculated,
  rep.fuel_litres_reported
FROM loc, calc, rep;

INSERT INTO financial_audits (
  location_id, 
  period_start, 
  period_end, 
  fuel_litres_calculated, 
  fuel_litres_reported, 
  fuel_litres_by_receipts, 
  receipt_amount_uah, 
  delta_calculated_reported, 
  has_anomaly, 
  anomaly_note
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.location_id }}'::uuid, 
  '{{ $json.period_start }}'::date, 
  '{{ $json.period_end }}'::date,
  {{ $json.fuel_litres_calculated }}, 
  {{ $json.fuel_litres_reported }}, 
  {{ $json.fuel_litres_by_receipts || 'NULL' }}, 
  {{ $json.receipt_amount_uah || 'NULL' }}, 
  {{ $json.delta_calculated_reported }}, 
  {{ $json.has_anomaly }}, 
  {{ $json.anomaly_note ? "'" + $json.anomaly_note + "'" : 'NULL' }}
) RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO alerts (company_id, location_id, type, message)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Calculate Delta').first().json.company_id }}'::uuid, 
  '{{ $('Calculate Delta').first().json.location_id }}'::uuid, 
  'anomaly', 
  '{{ $('Calculate Delta').first().json.alert_message }}'
);

SELECT u.telegram_id 
FROM users u
JOIN user_company_memberships m ON m.user_id = u.id
WHERE m.company_id = '{{ $('Calculate Delta').first().json.company_id }}'::uuid
  AND m.role IN ('owner', 'manager')
  AND u.telegram_id IS NOT NULL;
